mapper.sql: select a.address_id, a.courtyard_id, c.courtyard_name, a.address_name, a.place_type, a.tenant_name, a.tenant_phone, a.status, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from ins_address a left join ins_courtyard c on a.courtyard_id = c.courtyard_id
mapper.select: where a.status = '0' and a.courtyard_id = #{courtyardId} and a.address_name like concat('%', #{addressName}, '%') limit 10
mapper.insert: insert into ins_address(courtyard_id, address_name, place_type, tenant_name, tenant_phone, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{courtyardId}, #{addressName}, #{placeType}, #{tenantName}, #{tenantPhone}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
